characters.name: Ræven
characters.description: A cunning fox with a sleek, reddish-brown coat and a distinct white tip on its tail. It is depicted in a Nordic landscape, symbolizing its role in the story. The fox is agile and appears mischievous, reflecting its trickster nature in the tale.

characters.name: Smeden
characters.description: A strong, burly man, tall and muscular, wearing a leather apron typical for a blacksmith. His arms are muscular from years of working with heavy tools. He has a crafty look in his eyes, hinting at his cleverness. He is associated with the old smithy, known for the sign: 'Her bor Mesteren over alle Mestere!'

characters.name: Vor Herre
characters.description: A man symbolizing God, portrayed as wise and benevolent. He is dignified with a calm and gentle expression. During the scene re-shoeing the horse, he uses glowing, magical tools, demonstrating a heavenly aura.

characters.name: Konen
characters.description: An old lady, hunched and wrinkled, embodying age and weariness. During the transformation scene, she is enveloped in a fantastical display of light and magic, turning into a young, beautiful maiden with smooth skin and graceful features.

characters.name: Fanden
characters.description: Depicted as a frustrated, comical figure with exaggerated features. In one scene, he is stuck in a pear tree, showing an annoyed expression. In another, he is squirming inside a hot steel wire purse, surrounded by exaggerated sparks, indicating his discomfort.

characters.name: Skræddersvenden
characters.description: A slender and agile young man, carrying a tailor's iron with him. He appears quick and resourceful, managing to slip through the heavenly gate just in time, contrasting with Smeden's larger and slower form.
